description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams used for filtering employee salary search queries within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class, specifies allowed sort fields, and contains a property for employee number with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO used for filtering employee salary search parameters, including sorting options and employee number filter, extending the base FilterParams class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
